contexts.text: The body is only as it were a covering...
Under Covering, see this reference.

The hanging for the door of the tent () = the appearances of good and truth... which are the intermediate ones in which are the Angels of the Second Heaven... For there were five pillars and bases for this hanging, by which number is signified what is relatively little...

The hanging for the door of the court () = the appearances of good and truth... which are of the lowest Rational, in which are the Angels of the First Heaven... Its pillars were not covered over with gold, but were girt with silver... and their bases were of brass...
Her covering or clothing () = the support of the exterior life; for, in the spiritual sense, covering or garment = lower scientifics, and these an what spiritually support the external life of man.
Because it is his covering only () = because sensuous things have been laid under interior ones. Covering or garment = what is sensuous.
A cloud by day, a smoke by night, and a covering () = the veiling over of Divine truth; thus accommodation according to apprehension. AE 294:10. AE 594:15.
The good of love is the Celestial, and the truth of faith is its covering; for truths cover goods.
Thou shalt make a covering for the tent () = a compass; for the covering made of skins of red rams made a compass above and around the tent.
And a covering of badgers skins from above () = outside of it... A covering = a compass.
In the externals with man there are four coverings. Explained... Like things are represented in the coverings which constituted the expanse of the tabernacle...
Thou shalt make a hanging for the door of the tent () = the medium uniting the Second with the First Heaven... AC 9689.

For the door of the court a hanging () = introduction into that Heaven, and a guard lest it be entered by any except those who are prepared... A hanging = a guard lest it be entered; for a door is guarded by a hanging.
A mitre is a covering for the head. AC 9949.
The covering of the head then appears to be taken away from them...
Her head-covering described.
As truths pellucid from good such as are in the sense of the letter are signified by these precious stones, they are called his covering (). AR 90:2. AE 717:9.
The common covering... called the skull.
A wonderful general influx through the integuments.
These truths are called the coverings of Judah ().
